name: Actica
summary:
Actica provides business and technical consultancy services across digital transformation, cyber security, systems engineering, and complex infrastructure programmes.

Together, we help organisations deliver secure, reliable, and operationally effective technology and infrastructure outcomes through combined consultancy, engineering, and delivery expertise.
overview:
Actica works with organisations across public sector, defence, national security, and enterprise environments to deliver consultancy, systems engineering, cyber security, and digital transformation services. Their expertise spans architecture, programme delivery, cyber security, cloud, data, and engineering across complex and mission-critical environments.  

Together, we support organisations across infrastructure transformation, operational delivery, systems integration, cyber security, and platform modernisation initiatives. Through combined technical, consultancy, and delivery expertise, we help customers navigate complex operational and infrastructure environments with confidence.

Our focus is on building strong operational and technical foundations that support long-term resilience, governance, and delivery success. This includes technical consultancy, systems integration, programme delivery, operational enablement, platform security, and infrastructure transformation across complex environments.

We help organisations reduce delivery complexity, improve operational resilience, and deliver technology programmes with confidence.
